title: Booking a flight
instructions: Kemal telefonda uçak bileti ayırtıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; tarih, saat, bagaj ve fiyattaki değişikliklere dikkat et.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: Hi. I'd like to book a flight to Amsterdam on the fourteenth of March.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: Return, please. Coming back on the twentieth.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: There's a flight at six fifteen in the morning for ninety euros, or one at two in the afternoon for a hundred and thirty.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: Six fifteen is very early. But forty euros is a big difference... OK, the morning flight.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Do you need to check in a bag?

script.speaker: agent
script.text: That's twenty-five euros extra each way.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: Hmm. Can I take a small bag on the plane for free?

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Yes, one small bag under the seat is free.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: Then I'll only take a small bag. It's just six days.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Fine. So that's ninety euros in total.

questions.feedback: Mart'ın yirmisinde (the twentieth) dönüyor. On dört gidiş tarihi.

questions.prompt: Why does Kemal choose the morning flight?
questions.feedback: Çok erken ama kırk euro daha ucuz.
questions.evidence: But forty euros is a big difference

questions.prompt: How much is a suitcase each way?
questions.feedback: Valiz her yön için yirmi beş euro ekstra.
questions.evidence: That's twenty-five euros extra each way.

questions.prompt: How much does Kemal pay in total?
questions.feedback: Valiz almadan, sadece küçük çantayla: toplam doksan euro.
questions.evidence: So that's ninety euros in total.
